title: Sum two channels until both close
prompt:
Write `Sum2(a, b <-chan int) int`.

Read from both channels as values arrive, in whatever order they come, and return the sum of everything received once **both** are closed. One channel may close long before the other, and either may stay quiet for a while.

`a`: 1 2 3, `b`: 10 20 → `36`.
hint: `select` over both; when one is closed (`ok == false`), set it to `nil` so its case never fires again; stop when both are nil.
